attributes.action: Protect 5-Year ILR Route for Care Workers Who Switched Before New Rules Starts
attributes.additional_details:
Many healthcare workers were already legally living and working in the UK long before switching to the Health and Care Worker visa route.

These workers have contributed to essential services and made significant career, financial and family decisions based on the existing 5-year settlement pathway.

Changes should apply prospectively, not retrospectively, to protect legitimate expectations and provide certainty for existing workers and their families.
attributes.background:
We petition the Government to protect the existing 5-year (ILR) pathway for care workers who switched before the proposed 10-year rules legally take effect.

An Immigration White Paper or policy announcement should not be treated as the legal commencement of the new immigration rule.

rejection.details:
